modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

ai-connection.note: Any number of ChatGPT subscriptions on the same accounts page as Claude (chatgpt-connection #6; engine ghcr.io/humanitylabs-org/wizard-chatgpt:0.2.6@sha256:72be4ede5a2e0151eea3a9050611352b0b14c044e56c1202a25442f4003552e3, amd64+arm64, wizard-app-store #33+#36 at 81758d58, run 40465361129). 0.2.4 plus design rules v0 page (wizard-app-store #34) and Home names Hermes' default sign-in labels 'ChatGPT', 'ChatGPT 2' (#33). Sign-ins run inside the agent (stock `hermes auth add openai-codex` through the wizard-os plugin broker); an unreachable agent is reported with Retry. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Any number of Claude subscriptions (claude-connection #6; engine ghcr.io/humanitylabs-org/wizard-claude:0.2.8@sha256:7e7956086a2f8810b46666e5948c71ffc2637e1e54566eaffb100fb8acdc406c, amd64+arm64, wizard-app-store #33+#36 at 81758d58, run 40465361122). 0.2.6 plus design rules v0 page (#34); the original Claude Code sign-in and an agent row merge only on the agent's exact emailHash (Agent Service #196/#203), masked-email matching only for older agent services (#33). Added subscriptions sign in inside the agent (stock `hermes auth add anthropic`) through the wizard-os plugin broker. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager still binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude; tokens are never copied.
